vulnerability.name: USN-5839-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5839-1 fixed a vulnerability in Apache. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Dimas Fariski Setyawan Putra discovered that the Apache HTTP Server  mod_proxy module incorrectly truncated certain response headers. This may  result in later headers not being interpreted by the client.  (CVE-2022-37436)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in Apache HTTP Server. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
